claim.quote: Stringent limits on weakly interacting massive particles interacting via spin-dependent proton and spin-independent processes are set, and most interpretations of the DAMA/LIBRA modulation signal as dark matter interacting with iodine nuclei are ruled out.

name: Dark Matter Search Results from the PICO-60 CF$_3$I Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: The first PICO-60 run, with 36.8 kg of CF3I at SNOLAB, set strong limits on dark matter and ruled out most ways of reading the DAMA/LIBRA yearly-modulation signal as dark matter scattering off iodine.
summary.technical: 36.8 kg CF3I, 92.8 analysed live days (3415 kg-days taken June 2013-May 2014); a large population of unknown background events with acoustic, spatial and timing behaviour inconsistent with dark matter was removed by analysis cuts that retain 48.2% of the exposure (Phys. Rev. D 93, 052014).

title: Dark Matter Search Results from the PICO-60 CF$_3$I Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract says most interpretations of the DAMA/LIBRA modulation signal as dark matter interacting with iodine nuclei are ruled out.
